WITH b AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(p.name_given, p.name_first || ' ' || p.name_last) AS name,
         CAST(NULLIF(bt.g, '') AS INTEGER) AS g,
         CAST(NULLIF(bt.r, '') AS INTEGER) AS r,
         CAST(NULLIF(bt.h, '') AS INTEGER) AS h,
         CAST(NULLIF(bt.hr, '') AS INTEGER) AS hr
  FROM batting bt JOIN player p ON bt.player_id = p.player_id
),
m AS (
  SELECT MAX(g) AS mg, MAX(r) AS mr, MAX(h) AS mh, MAX(hr) AS mhr FROM b
)
SELECT 'games played' AS stat, name, g AS value FROM b, m WHERE g = mg
UNION ALL
SELECT 'runs', name, r FROM b, m WHERE r = mr
UNION ALL
SELECT 'hits', name, h FROM b, m WHERE h = mh
UNION ALL
SELECT 'home runs', name, hr FROM b, m WHERE hr = mhr;
rows.review: The query returns 15448 rows when each stat should have only a few tied winners, and the `value` column is blank for the runs rows, which suggests the join fans out (the `player` table may have duplicate `player_id` values) and the outer comparison is not matching what you intend. Fix it by confirming `player.player_id` is unique (or joining to a deduplicated player subquery), computing the maxima from the same CTE `b` instead of the raw `batting` table, and returning one row per stat with `stat`, `name`, and `value`. Also decide whether the output should be single-season maxima (current default) or career totals, since the brief leaves this open.

WITH hu AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.case_id FROM parties p
  JOIN collisions c ON c.case_id = p.case_id
  WHERE c.motorcycle_collision = 1
    AND (p.party_safety_equipment_1 IN ('driver, motorcycle helmet used','passenger, motorcycle helmet used')
         OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 IN ('driver, motorcycle helmet used','passenger, motorcycle helmet used'))
),
hn AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.case_id FROM parties p
  JOIN collisions c ON c.case_id = p.case_id
  WHERE c.motorcycle_collision = 1
    AND (p.party_safety_equipment_1 IN ('driver, motorcycle helmet not used','passenger, motorcycle helmet not used')
         OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 IN ('driver, motorcycle helmet not used','passenger, motorcycle helmet not used'))
)
SELECT 'helmet used' AS helmet_group,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(COALESCE(c.motorcyclist_killed_count, 0)) / COUNT(*), 2) AS motorcyclist_fatality_percent
FROM hu JOIN collisions c ON c.case_id = hu.case_id
UNION ALL
SELECT 'helmet not used',
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(COALESCE(c.motorcyclist_killed_count, 0)) / COUNT(*), 2)
FROM hn JOIN collisions c ON c.case_id = hn.case_id;

WITH dup AS (SELECT case_id FROM case_ids GROUP BY case_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1), counts AS (SELECT c.db_year, k.primary_collision_factor AS pcf, COUNT(*) AS n FROM collisions k JOIN case_ids c ON k.case_id = c.case_id WHERE k.primary_collision_factor IS NOT NULL AND c.case_id NOT IN (SELECT case_id FROM dup) GROUP BY c.db_year, k.primary_collision_factor), ranked AS (SELECT db_year, pcf, n, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY db_year ORDER BY n DESC, pcf) AS rk FROM counts) SELECT db_year, pcf AS primary_collision_factor, n AS collision_count, rk FROM ranked WHERE rk <= 2 ORDER BY db_year, rk

WITH bat AS (
  SELECT b.bowler AS pid, SUM(s.runs_scored) AS runs
  FROM ball_by_ball b
  JOIN batsman_scored s ON s.match_id = b.match_id AND s.over_id = b.over_id
    AND s.ball_id = b.ball_id AND s.innings_no = b.innings_no
  GROUP BY b.bowler
),
ext AS (
  SELECT b.bowler AS pid, SUM(e.extra_runs) AS runs
  FROM ball_by_ball b
  JOIN extra_runs e ON e.match_id = b.match_id AND e.over_id = b.over_id
    AND e.ball_id = b.ball_id AND e.innings_no = b.innings_no
  WHERE e.extra_type NOT IN ('byes', 'legbyes')
  GROUP BY b.bowler
),
wk AS (
  SELECT b.bowler AS pid, COUNT(*) AS w
  FROM ball_by_ball b
  JOIN wicket_taken t ON t.match_id = b.match_id AND t.over_id = b.over_id
    AND t.ball_id = b.ball_id AND t.innings_no = b.innings_no
  WHERE t.kind_out NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
  GROUP BY b.bowler
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT p.player_name AS player_name,
         (COALESCE(bat.runs, 0) + COALESCE(ext.runs, 0)) * 1.0 / wk.w AS bowling_average
  FROM wk
  JOIN player p ON p.player_id = wk.pid
  LEFT JOIN bat ON bat.pid = wk.pid
  LEFT JOIN ext ON ext.pid = wk.pid
  WHERE wk.w >= 10
)
SELECT player_name, bowling_average
FROM ranked
WHERE bowling_average = (SELECT MIN(bowling_average) FROM ranked);

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM (
    SELECT bb.striker AS player_id, bb.match_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS total_runs
    FROM batsman_scored bs
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb
      ON bs.match_id = bb.match_id
     AND bs.over_id = bb.over_id
     AND bs.ball_id = bb.ball_id
     AND bs.innings_no = bb.innings_no
    GROUP BY bb.striker, bb.match_id
) t
JOIN player_match pm ON pm.match_id = t.match_id AND pm.player_id = t.player_id
JOIN match m ON m.match_id = t.match_id
JOIN player p ON p.player_id = t.player_id
WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL
  AND pm.team_id <> m.match_winner
  AND t.total_runs >= 100
ORDER BY p.player_name;

SELECT p.player_name,
       ROUND(SUM(bs.runs_scored) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT bb.match_id), 2) AS batting_average
FROM batsman_scored bs
JOIN ball_by_ball bb
  ON bs.match_id = bb.match_id
 AND bs.over_id = bb.over_id
 AND bs.ball_id = bb.ball_id
 AND bs.innings_no = bb.innings_no
JOIN match m ON bb.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN player p ON bb.striker = p.player_id
WHERE m.season_id = 5
GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY batting_average DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH bowl AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT match_id, innings_no, over_id, bowler FROM ball_by_ball
),
over_runs AS (
  SELECT b.match_id, b.innings_no, b.over_id, b.bowler,
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(bs.runs_scored) FROM batsman_scored bs
              WHERE bs.match_id = b.match_id AND bs.innings_no = b.innings_no AND bs.over_id = b.over_id), 0)
    + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(er.extra_runs) FROM extra_runs er
              WHERE er.match_id = b.match_id AND er.innings_no = b.innings_no AND er.over_id = b.over_id
                AND er.extra_type NOT IN ('byes', 'legbyes')), 0) AS total
  FROM bowl b
),
match_max AS (
  SELECT match_id, MAX(total) AS mx FROM over_runs GROUP BY match_id
),
top_overs AS (
  SELECT o.* FROM over_runs o
  JOIN match_max m ON o.match_id = m.match_id AND o.total = m.mx
)
SELECT bowler, match_id, innings_no, over_id, total AS runs_conceded
FROM top_overs
ORDER BY runs_conceded DESC, match_id, innings_no, over_id
LIMIT 3;

WITH months(m) AS (
  SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6
  UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12
),
delivered AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT order_id,
         CAST(substr(order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS yr,
         CAST(substr(order_purchase_timestamp, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) AS mo
  FROM olist_orders
  WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
)
SELECT m AS month,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN yr = 2016 THEN order_id END) AS "2016",
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN yr = 2017 THEN order_id END) AS "2017",
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN yr = 2018 THEN order_id END) AS "2018"
FROM months
LEFT JOIN delivered ON delivered.mo = months.m
GROUP BY m
ORDER BY m

WITH cat_pay AS (
  SELECT t.product_category_name_english AS category,
         p.payment_type AS payment_type,
         COUNT(DISTINCT p.order_id || '|' || p.payment_sequential) AS payments
  FROM olist_order_payments p
  JOIN olist_order_items i ON i.order_id = p.order_id
  JOIN olist_products pr ON pr.product_id = i.product_id
  JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON t.product_category_name = pr.product_category_name
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT category, payment_type, payments,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY payments DESC, payment_type ASC) AS rn
  FROM cat_pay
)
SELECT category AS product_category_name_english, payment_type, payments
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY payments DESC, category ASC
LIMIT 3;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT c.name AS name,
         SUM((julianday(r.return_date) - julianday(r.rental_date)) * 24) AS total_hours
  FROM rental r
  JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
  JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
  JOIN film_category fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id
  JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id
  JOIN customer cu ON r.customer_id = cu.customer_id
  JOIN address a ON cu.address_id = a.address_id
  JOIN city ci ON a.city_id = ci.city_id
  WHERE r.return_date IS NOT NULL
    AND (ci.city LIKE 'A%' OR ci.city LIKE '%-%')
  GROUP BY c.name
)
SELECT name, total_hours
FROM t
WHERE total_hours = (SELECT MAX(total_hours) FROM t);

SELECT t.boroname, COUNT(*) AS tree_count, AVG(i.Estimate_Mean_income) AS avg_mean_income FROM trees t JOIN income_trees i ON t.zipcode = i.zipcode WHERE i.Estimate_Median_income > 0 AND i.Estimate_Mean_income > 0 AND t.boroname IN ('Bronx','Brooklyn','Manhattan','Queens','Staten Island') GROUP BY t.boroname ORDER BY tree_count DESC LIMIT 3

WITH top_industry AS (
  SELECT industry
  FROM companies_industries
  GROUP BY industry
  ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT company_id) DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.company_id) * 1.0 / 3 AS avg_new_unicorns_per_year
FROM companies_dates d
JOIN companies_industries i ON i.company_id = d.company_id
WHERE i.industry = (SELECT industry FROM top_industry)
  AND strftime('%Y', d.date_joined) IN ('2019', '2020', '2021');

WITH s AS (
  SELECT s.prod_id, c.cust_city, t.calendar_quarter_id AS q, s.amount_sold
  FROM sales s JOIN customers c ON c.cust_id = s.cust_id JOIN times t ON t.time_id = s.time_id
  WHERE c.country_id = 52790 AND s.promo_id = 999 AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
),
city AS (
  SELECT cust_city FROM s GROUP BY cust_city
  HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN q = 1772 THEN amount_sold ELSE 0 END) > 0
     AND SUM(CASE WHEN q = 1776 THEN amount_sold ELSE 0 END) >= 1.2 * SUM(CASE WHEN q = 1772 THEN amount_sold ELSE 0 END)
),
f AS (SELECT s.* FROM s JOIN city USING (cust_city)),
tt AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN q = 1772 THEN amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS t19, SUM(CASE WHEN q = 1776 THEN amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS t20 FROM f),
pq AS (SELECT prod_id,
   SUM(CASE WHEN q = 1772 THEN amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS a,
   SUM(CASE WHEN q = 1776 THEN amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS b,
   SUM(amount_sold) AS total
  FROM f GROUP BY prod_id),
ranked AS (SELECT prod_id, a, b, total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total DESC) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS n FROM pq),
top AS (SELECT r.* FROM ranked r WHERE r.rn <= 0.2 * r.n),
chg AS (
  SELECT top.prod_id, 100.0 * top.b / tt.t20 - 100.0 * top.a / tt.t19 AS d
  FROM top CROSS JOIN tt
)
SELECT p.prod_name
FROM chg JOIN products p ON p.prod_id = chg.prod_id
WHERE ABS(chg.d) = (SELECT MIN(ABS(d)) FROM chg);

WITH yash AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(p.PID) AS pid FROM Person p WHERE TRIM(p.Name) = 'Yash Chopra'
),
yf AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(d.MID) AS MID FROM M_Director d WHERE TRIM(d.PID) IN (SELECT pid FROM yash)
),
ac AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(c.PID) AS apid, TRIM(c.MID) AS MID FROM M_Cast c
),
dir AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(d.MID) AS MID, TRIM(d.PID) AS dpid FROM M_Director d
),
yc AS (
  SELECT ac.apid, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.MID) AS yc
  FROM ac JOIN yf ON ac.MID = yf.MID
  GROUP BY ac.apid
),
oc AS (
  SELECT ac.apid, dir.dpid, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.MID) AS n
  FROM ac JOIN dir ON ac.MID = dir.MID
  WHERE dir.dpid NOT IN (SELECT pid FROM yash)
  GROUP BY ac.apid, dir.dpid
),
om AS (
  SELECT apid, MAX(n) AS mx FROM oc GROUP BY apid
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS actor_count
FROM yc LEFT JOIN om ON yc.apid = om.apid
WHERE yc.yc > COALESCE(om.mx, 0);

WITH scores AS (
  SELECT ms.StyleName AS StyleName,
         SUM(CASE mp.PreferenceSeq WHEN 1 THEN 3 WHEN 2 THEN 2 WHEN 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score
  FROM Musical_Preferences mp
  JOIN Musical_Styles ms ON mp.StyleID = ms.StyleID
  GROUP BY mp.StyleID, ms.StyleName
),
avg_s AS (
  SELECT AVG(total_score) AS avg_score FROM scores
)
SELECT s.StyleName,
       ABS(s.total_score - a.avg_score) AS abs_difference
FROM scores s
CROSS JOIN avg_s a
ORDER BY s.StyleName;

WITH s AS (
  SELECT salespersonid AS sp, strftime('%Y', orderdate) AS yr, SUM(totaldue) AS sales
  FROM salesorderheader
  WHERE salespersonid IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY salespersonid, strftime('%Y', orderdate)
),
q AS (
  SELECT BusinessEntityID AS sp, strftime('%Y', QuotaDate) AS yr, SUM(SalesQuota) AS quota
  FROM SalesPersonQuotaHistory
  GROUP BY BusinessEntityID, strftime('%Y', QuotaDate)
),
k AS (
  SELECT sp, yr FROM s
  UNION
  SELECT sp, yr FROM q
)
SELECT k.sp AS BusinessEntityID,
       k.yr AS Year,
       COALESCE(s.sales, 0) - COALESCE(q.quota, 0) AS Difference
FROM k
LEFT JOIN s ON s.sp = k.sp AND s.yr = k.yr
LEFT JOIN q ON q.sp = k.sp AND q.yr = k.yr
ORDER BY k.sp, k.yr;
rows.review: Rows where a salesperson-year has quota but no sales (or sales but no quota) return NULL for Difference, because `s.sales - q.quota` is NULL when either side is missing. A year with quota but no sales should show `-quota`, not NULL. Fix the final SELECT to `COALESCE(s.sales, 0) - COALESCE(q.quota, 0) AS Difference`, or add a note explaining the NULLs for missing-side rows. Also state in the answer that 2014 covers only partial quota periods (through 2014-03), and confirm the STATUS filter (the brief says to check it, and the SQL does not apply or verify it).
